title: Zoho CRM pricing - Free through $52/user/month Ultimate tier
clean_text: Zoho CRM offers a genuine Free plan plus four paid tiers (annual billing): Standard at $14/user/month, Professional at $23/user/month (the most popular tier for growing businesses), Enterprise at $40/user/month (adds Zia AI, predictive analytics, custom modules, encryption at rest), and Ultimate at $52/user/month for large enterprises with custom needs. Monthly billing raises Standard to $20 and Professional to $35 per user/month. A separate Team Users add-on for non-sales team members costs $9/user/month.
